title: hedera.com now points builders to a 'Hedera Foundation' (hedera.foundation) distinct from the profile's stated 'Hashgraph Association'
summary: The registry profile for Hedera says ecosystem funding flows primarily through the independent Hashgraph Association. Hedera's own homepage now links its funding/investment activity to 'Hedera Foundation' at hedera.foundation, which describes backing DeFi/enterprise projects and cites an investment in a Fidelity International tokenized fund via Archax — a different kind of activity (treasury investment, not grants). Unclear if this is a rename, a second funding arm, or a different entity; worth the owner confirming before the profile is edited.

title: schmidt-futures.yaml and schmidt-sciences.yaml are duplicate org files for the same organization
summary: schmidt-futures.yaml's own profile states its website 'now redirects to Schmidt Sciences' and lists Schmidt Sciences programs (AI2050, five research centers). A separate, fuller org file already exists at schmidt-sciences.yaml (website schmidtsciences.org, funding block filled, owns the schmidt-sciences-trustworthy-ai program). These look like the same funder under an old name and a new name, not two organizations. Recommend the owner decide which id to keep canonical and merge/retire the other (schmidt-futures' aka already lists 'Schmidt Sciences', supporting a merge into schmidt-sciences with schmidt-futures kept only as an aka).

title: Spotify FOSS Fund has no program file despite being the org's named flagship funding vehicle
summary: Spotify's own engineering blog describes the FOSS Fund (established 2022 at €100,000) and its 2025 cohort: FFmpeg (€30k), Xiph.Org (€25k), and MSW (€15k). There is no external application — Spotify's internal engineers nominate projects (informed by internal dependency data) and a fund committee selects recipients. No program file currently exists for it.
